# Dell-shaped outputs (hand-written)

Written by hand in the exact format of ipmitool 1.8.19, after the sensor names
and entity ids an iDRAC 7 reports on a PowerEdge R720 (two processor sensors
both named `Temp`, `Pwr Consumption` in Watts, discrete power supply and
redundancy sensors). Not captured from a real server: the serial numbers and
values are invented. The other fixtures of `test/fixtures/ipmitool/` were
captured from the OpenIPMI simulator (`ipmi_sim`).
